reasoning_content:
The alert region is empty. Let's check the id="alert" div and see if there's an error message. Also, it's possible that the login actually succeeded but the session cookie wasn't persisted... GET /admin returned a 302 to sign_in, so it means the session isn't authenticated. Let's check the contents of the alert div and the session.

Actually, wait — maybe the login succeeded, but my cookie jar handling failed (e.g., the session cookie uses different flags, or CSRF). Let's check the session cookie in cj.txt. Also, let's check the response to /admin: 302 to sign_in — an unauthenticated redirect.

Another possibility: Devise's sign_in POST is returning 200 with a re-rendered form — in that case, there should be an error like "Invalid Email or password" displayed. Let's look at the contents of the alert div more carefully, and also check the form's error summary.

action.command: cd /tmp && sed -n '/id="alert"/,/\/div>/p' resp.html | head -15; echo "=== cookie jar ==="; cat cj.txt; echo "=== try login, dump status and key markers ==="; rm -f cj2.txt; TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj2.txt http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in | grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -v -b cj2.txt -c cj2.txt -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678" -o resp2.html 2>&1 | grep -E "^< HTTP|^< Set-Cookie"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && sed -n '/id=\"alert\"/,/\\/div>/p' resp.html | head -15; echo \"=== cookie jar ===\"; cat cj.txt; echo \"=== try login, dump status and key markers ===\"; rm -f cj2.txt; TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj2.txt http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in | grep -oE 'name=\"authenticity_token\" value=\"[^\"]*\"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value=\"//;s/\"//'); curl -s -v -b cj2.txt -c cj2.txt -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode \"authenticity_token=$TOKEN\" --data-urlencode \"user[email]=admin@consul.dev\" --data-urlencode \"user[password]=Aa12345678\" -o resp2.html 2>&1 | grep -E \"^< HTTP|^< Set-Cookie\" ", "summary": "Inspect alert div, cookies, and login response headers"}
